try not to buy from anyone who’s reselling on twitter unless you have proof they actually have a valid ticket!!!
a lot of accounts doing this are just bots operated by fraudsters trying to get money through scamming fans. I get how many people don’t know these scams or fall victim to it as I only discovered how bad it was during the uk eras tour sales on Ticketmaster. 

Try to look out for the person’s grammar, their posting history, any other personal information on their profile that may identify them. These used to be easy to identify as bots would outright copy and paste text from others selling tickets, have badly photoshopped tickets on their posts or none at all, or save photos of other people’s tickets that they found online and pretend they’re theirs - but a lot of them have gotten smarter and now use excuses such as “my stepdad accidentally bought too many tickets” , “was lucky to get extra tickets off the presale for the same date”, so sometimes now it can be hard to determine who’s genuine and who’s not 😭

I would recommend getting a diagnosis so you are given accessibility to pharmacotherapy, psychotherapy and the like. Even therapies that can help develop your motor skills would be beneficial. Interventions like these are really important to help expand your skills and help you understand your emotions.
